---
name: Problem with data
about: An act, a field or a file is missing, wrong or broken in the dataset or the bucket
title: ''
labels: data
assignees: ''

---

**The act**
Its ELI (for example `DU/2026/1`) or address (`WDU20260000001`). For many acts: the journal and years.

**What is wrong**
[the act is missing / a file is missing / a file is broken or empty / a field is wrong / the copy is older than the source / other]

**Where you saw it**
[the dataset on Hugging Face / the bucket on Hugging Face / the space / your own gathering]
The path of the file, if you have it (for example `DU/2026/WDU20260000001.pdf`).

**What the source says**
Open the same act at the source and say whether it is right there:

```
https://api.sejm.gov.pl/eli/acts/DU/2026/1
```

 - [ ] the source is right and our copy differs
 - [ ] the source itself is wrong or incomplete
 - [ ] I did not check

**Additional context**
The date you looked. Our copy keeps what the source said on the day of gathering.
